thread.title: Lawrence: Video of deadly Minneapolis ICE shooting exposes Trump & Noem's lies
thread.title_full: Lawrence: Video of deadly Minneapolis ICE shooting exposes Trump & Noem's lies

author: @aotearoawhanau7211
text: It would already help if unqualified and unauthorised politicians and TV pundits would stop coming up with statements and conclusion before an independent criminal investigation is finished. Even worse such statements are made without knowing all facts. Being advocate´s devil: Noem could have referred to the grey car at the left of the killed woman´s car. Another point. The woman was talking to the police waving her arm outside the window. Maybe she tried to signal that she is bringing the car around to facilitate to remove the grey car. We do not see what has happened before the shooting. One more thought. I am not sure whether it is really helpful to show the video (and many others in shootings before) before an investigation is finished. Going through the sites of many media - the comments are really disturbing. Either murderer or FAFO.. Those opinions will be difficult to change no matter what the conclusion of the investigtion will be. Finally, It will be important as well to establish how much training the ICE officer had. No well trained police officer would stand in front or even slightly in front of a car. In this position he cannot protect himself in case a driver is trying to hit him and he is not in a position to protect his colleagues.
